exp.desc:
- Guest service for up to 120 covers
- Complaints, cash-up and till system
- Training new staff

cl.p1: After eight years waiting tables in busy restaurants, I know the moment when a customer’s patience runs out – and how to bring the conversation back. I would like to use that skill on the phone with your customers.
cl.p2: I handled table bookings, complaints and the end-of-day cash-up, and I trained new staff on our till system. I type quickly and accurately, and I have completed an online course on telephone customer service to prepare for this move.
cl.p3: I have a quiet home office with a fibre connection and can work early and late shifts, including Saturdays. I would be glad to take part in a phone interview.

cl.p1: Over the past four years I have handled more than 30,000 customer contacts, mainly about broadband faults and bills. I would now like to work on the cases that cannot be solved in the first call.
cl.p2: My satisfaction scores have been above the team average for two years, and I train new starters on our systems. I walk customers through router settings step by step and know when to book an engineer. Most faults are simpler than they sound. I write case notes so that nobody has to ask the customer the same question twice.
cl.p3: I am happy to work shifts and weekends and can start with four weeks’ notice.

letters.label: Experienced advisor moving to second line
